name: Quit Journey
description: A complete addiction-recovery program for nicotine, alcohol, drugs and behavioural addictions: recovery timelines, savings and rewards, cravings with personal coping insights, harm reduction (naloxone, drug checking, safety timer), if-then plans, validated check-in scales, medication schedules, programs, slips without shame and a support network.

global.schema:
enum ProductType { CIGARETTES ROLL_YOUR_OWN CIGARS VAPE HEATED_TOBACCO OTHER ALCOHOL CANNABIS OPIOIDS STIMULANTS BENZODIAZEPINES KRATOM GAMBLING GAMING PORNOGRAPHY SOCIAL_MEDIA CAFFEINE SUGAR }
enum RecoveryGoal { ABSTINENCE REDUCTION }
enum CravingTrigger { STRESS COFFEE ALCOHOL AFTER_MEAL BOREDOM SOCIAL WORK DRIVING WAKING_UP PHONE ARGUMENT CELEBRATION LONELINESS OTHER HUNGRY ANGRY TIRED PAIN PAYDAY PEOPLE_PLACES SEEING_IT BAD_NEWS }
enum CopingStrategy { BREATHING WALK WATER SNACK GUM CALL_SOMEONE DISTRACTION EXERCISE MEDITATION QUIT_AID WAIT_IT_OUT OTHER URGE_SURFING SUPPORT_MEETING PLAY_THE_TAPE COLD_WATER PRAYER }
enum CravingOutcome { RESISTED SMOKED }
enum QuitAidType { PATCH GUM LOZENGE INHALER MOUTH_SPRAY NASAL_SPRAY VARENICLINE BUPROPION CYTISINE COUNSELING APP_PROGRAM OTHER METHADONE BUPRENORPHINE NALTREXONE ACAMPROSATE DISULFIRAM SUPPORT_GROUP THERAPY }
enum WithdrawalSymptom { IRRITABILITY ANXIETY RESTLESSNESS INSOMNIA HUNGER HEADACHE LOW_MOOD POOR_CONCENTRATION COUGH CONSTIPATION DIZZINESS NAUSEA SWEATING MUSCLE_ACHES TREMOR CHILLS VIVID_DREAMS ANHEDONIA DIARRHEA }

type QuitPlan {
    quitDateTime: DateTime!
    productType: ProductType!
    unitsPerDay: Float!
    unitsPerPack: Int!
    packPrice: Float!
    currency: Currency!
    yearsSmoked: Float
    customName: String
    unitLabel: String
    goal: RecoveryGoal
    dailyLimit: Float
    standardDrinkGrams: Float
}

type Motivation {
    id: OID!
    text: String!
    imageUrl: URL
}

type Craving {
    id: OID!
    timestamp: DateTime!
    intensity: Int!
    trigger: CravingTrigger!
    strategy: CopingStrategy
    outcome: CravingOutcome!
    durationMinutes: Int
    note: String
    intensityAfter: Int
}

type Slip {
    id: OID!
    timestamp: DateTime!
    units: Float!
    trigger: CravingTrigger
    note: String
}

type QuitAttempt {
    id: OID!
    quitDateTime: DateTime!
    endedAt: DateTime!
    reason: String
}

type CheckIn {
    id: OID!
    date: String!
    mood: Int!
    cravingLevel: Int!
    energy: Int
    sleepQuality: Int
    weightKg: Float
    symptoms: [WithdrawalSymptom!]!
    note: String
}

type RewardGoal {
    id: OID!
    title: String!
    cost: Float!
    emoji: String
    claimedAt: DateTime
}

type QuitAid {
    id: OID!
    type: QuitAidType!
    name: String
    dosage: String
    startedAt: DateTime!
    endedAt: DateTime
}

type AidUse {
    id: OID!
    aidId: OID!
    timestamp: DateTime!
    note: String
    beforeDrinking: Boolean
}

type SupportContact {
    id: OID!
    name: String!
    phone: String
    relation: String
}

type QuitJourneyState {
    displayName: String
    plan: QuitPlan
    motivations: [Motivation!]!
    prepTasksDone: [String!]!
    cravings: [Craving!]!
    slips: [Slip!]!
    pastAttempts: [QuitAttempt!]!
    checkIns: [CheckIn!]!
    rewards: [RewardGoal!]!
    aids: [QuitAid!]!
    aidUses: [AidUse!]!
    supportContacts: [SupportContact!]!
    quitlinePhone: String
    naloxoneKits: [NaloxoneKit!]
    drugChecks: [DrugCheck!]
    exclusions: [Exclusion!]
    ifThenPlans: [IfThenPlan!]
    drinks: [DrinkEntry!]
    screenTime: [ScreenTimeEntry!]
    gamblingLosses: [GamblingLoss!]
    assessments: [Assessment!]
    medicationPlans: [MedicationPlan!]
    takeHomes: [TakeHome!]
    programs: [ProgramEnrollment!]
}

enum NaloxoneKind { NASAL_SPRAY_4MG NASAL_SPRAY_8MG INJECTABLE AUTO_INJECTOR OTHER }
enum DrugTestType { FENTANYL_STRIP XYLAZINE_STRIP NITAZENE_STRIP MEDETOMIDINE_STRIP BENZO_STRIP REAGENT_KIT CHECKING_SERVICE OTHER }
enum DrugTestResult { POSITIVE NEGATIVE INCONCLUSIVE }
enum HarmReductionAction { DID_NOT_USE USED_LESS WENT_SLOWER NOT_ALONE NALOXONE_READY DISCARDED TOLD_SOMEONE }
enum BeverageType { BEER WINE SPIRITS CIDER COCKTAIL OTHER }
enum AssessmentInstrument { AUDIT_C AUDIT HSI CUDIT_R PGSI BARC_10 SOWS SAWS CWS ACSA }
enum MedicationPlanSource { CLINICIAN LEAFLET SELF }
enum ProgramKey { QUIT_VAPING DAILY_MISSIONS DRY_MONTH T_BREAK SKILL_LESSONS }
enum ExclusionScheme { GAMSTOP OASIS BETBLOCKER GAMBAN BANK_BLOCK VENUE OTHER }

type NaloxoneKit {
    id: OID!
    kind: NaloxoneKind!
    location: String
    expiresOn: String
    addedAt: DateTime!
    usedAt: DateTime
}

type DrugCheck {
    id: OID!
    checkedAt: DateTime!
    expectedSubstance: String
    testType: DrugTestType!
    result: DrugTestResult!
    actions: [HarmReductionAction!]!
    note: String
}

type Exclusion {
    id: OID!
    scheme: ExclusionScheme!
    startDate: String!
    endDate: String
    note: String
}

type IfThenPlan {
    id: OID!
    trigger: CravingTrigger
    ifText: String!
    thenText: String!
    strategy: CopingStrategy
    createdAt: DateTime!
    lastReviewedAt: DateTime
}

type DrinkEntry {
    id: OID!
    timestamp: DateTime!
    beverage: BeverageType!
    volumeMl: Float!
    abvPercent: Float!
    gramsAlcohol: Float!
    standardDrinks: Float!
    slipId: OID!
}

type ScreenTimeEntry {
    id: OID!
    date: String!
    minutes: Int!
}

type GamblingLoss {
    id: OID!
    date: String!
    amount: Float!
    note: String
}

type Assessment {
    id: OID!
    instrument: AssessmentInstrument!
    takenAt: DateTime!
    answers: [Int!]!
    score: Int!
}

type DoseStep {
    id: OID!
    fromDay: Int!
    dose: String!
    timesPerDay: Int!
}

type MedicationPlan {
    id: OID!
    aidId: OID!
    source: MedicationPlanSource!
    startDate: String!
    steps: [DoseStep!]!
    note: String
}

type TakeHome {
    id: OID!
    aidId: OID!
    pickedUpOn: String!
    doses: Int!
}

type ProgramEnrollment {
    id: OID!
    program: ProgramKey!
    startedAt: DateTime!
    completedMissions: [String!]!
    endedAt: DateTime
}
